title: Maker's Terrace
wikitext:
[[File:The Maker's Terrace.jpg|thumb|300px|The Maker's Terrace]]

'''The Maker's Terrace''' is a large excavation site located just outside the entrance to [[Uldaman]] in the [[Badlands]].  For most adventurers first venturing into the Badlands from [[Loch Modan]], it will be the first place they travel past. The Terrace is patrolled by [[Dark Iron clan|Dark Iron dwarves]].
